ModMetaData.description:
[h1]RimMind - Memory (v2.0)[/h1] Three-layer cognitive memory hierarchy and temporal context engine for RimWorld. Tracks colonist activities, combat milestones, interpersonal shifts, and colony-wide incidents—consolidating daily experiences into enduring long-term impressions and injecting structured historical context into all RimMind AI modules.
[b]v2.0 Clean Architecture & RimWorld 1.6 / 1.7 Dual-Version Support:[/b] [list] [*][b]RimWorld 1.6 & 1.7 (Waylith / .NET 10) Ready[/b]: Native multi-target compilation supporting both RimWorld 1.6 (.NET Framework 4.8) and RimWorld 1.7 (.NET 10 / Harmony 2.x & 3.x). [*][b]v2.0 4-Zone KV-Cache Prefix Alignment[/b]: Consolidated Deep/Reflective memories are aligned with Zone 2 static pawn profiles, achieving 80%+ prefix cache hit stability across seasons. Note: v1.x saves are not compatible with v2.0. [*][b]Biologically Inspired 3-Tier Storage[/b]: Combines Active (Sensory/Working), Archive (Episodic), and Deep/Dark (Long-Term Reflection) memory tiers with natural importance decay. [/list]
[h2]What Is RimMind[/h2] RimMind is an enterprise-grade, AI-powered RimWorld mod suite. Integrated with Large Language Models (LLM), it transforms colonists into self-reflecting agents with distinct personalities, three-tier memories, natural spoken dialogues, autonomous mechanisms, and dynamic storytelling.

[h2]Core Features[/h2] [list] [*][b]Active Memory (Tier 1)[/b] - Detailed chronological records of recent events, immediately available for conversational and tactical recall. [*][b]Archive Memory (Tier 2)[/b] - Importance-sorted episodic milestones that retain essential narrative facts while pruning trivial noise. [*][b]Deep / Dark Memory (Tier 3)[/b] - Permanent psychological impressions synthesized daily by AI (under 50 words each), capturing life-defining traumas, loyalties, and convictions. [*][b]Work Session Aggregation[/b] - Automatically merges consecutive identical jobs (e.g., "Hauled 12 items over 4.8 hours") into a single entry to prevent token bloat. [*][b]Natural Importance Decay & Storyteller Sync[/b] - Routine tasks fade over time while high-significance events (importance 0.8 or higher) persist and automatically synchronize to [code]RimMind-Storyteller[/code]'s narrative chronicle. [/list]

[h2]Frequently Asked Questions[/h2] [b]Q: Does Memory consume a lot of tokens?[/b] A: No. Work aggregation, configurable injection ratios, and Zone 2 KV-cache alignment keep token usage compact and cache-friendly.
[b]Q: Are memories saved with my colony save file?[/b] A: Yes. All three memory tiers for every colonist and the Storyteller are serialized in your RimWorld save file, and you can also pin or add custom manual memories in the UI.
